headline: Vale Executive Highlights Attractive Share Buyback Potential Amid Low Valuation
summary: A Vale director stated that the Brazilian mining company's shares are currently inexpensive, making share buybacks very attractive.
why: Corporate capital allocation announcements regarding share repurchases signal management's confidence in cash flows and valuation to equity investors.

impacts.name: Vale SA
impacts.why: Positive commentary on share buybacks can attract equity investor interest.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
